title: Man. Post. Cap. VII: Quinto — Gal 6:5 / Rom 14:12; account for Adam's act?
pass_a_gloss: Do you think that day we all and each must give account for Adam's actual sin? Has not God given each of us our own wills, faculties, actions, gifts? Of these we each must certainly give account; of Adam's deed done thousands of years before we began to exist, account is owed not by us but by Adam himself before God.
pass_b_english: Do you think that on that day account must be rendered by all and each of us for Adam's actual sin? Have not wills, faculties, actions, and gifts been attributed by God to each of us as our own? Of these indeed account will certainly have to be rendered by each of us; of Adam's action, perpetrated some thousands of years before we began to exist, account will not be owed by us, but by Adam himself before God.
source_text: Putasne in illa die nobis omnibus & singulis reddendam esse rationem de peccato actuali Adami? Nonne nobis singulis sua cuique attributa sunt a Deo voluntates, facultates, actiones, dotes? De his quidem certe reddenda erit ratio singulis nobis, de Adami actione aliquot annorum millibus antequam esse inciperemus perpetrato non erit nobis, sed ipsi Adamo reddenda apud Deum ratio.

lemmas.gloss: to be rendered by Adam himself

choices.choice: We account for own gifts; Adam for his act
